decision.observed_event: One round, 6 gp a side, settled on Insight. You lose 6 gp to the house.

appraisal.label: amusement
appraisal.cause: The rogue loses a quick round.

improv_read.player_bid: Wren asks to settle the round with a roll.
improv_read.connection: The house keeps winning and wants her to stay.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit follows the table result and keeps it brisk.

public_brief.objective: Keep her playing while she is losing.
public_brief.tactic: Soothe the loss as bad luck and invite another round.
public_brief.visible_cue: The fourth player laughs too loudly; the dealer hushes him.
public_brief.player_opening: She can play again or stop.
public_brief.reply_to: Just roll for this one, I'm tired of counting.
public_brief.kit_focus: Settle the round in one beat and give the table a quick reaction.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, dry humor: brisk result, a little needling

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Six gold a side this time, and no counting: the round comes down to reading the dealer across the table. Wren studies his face and finds nothing there she can trust. He turns his card, she turns hers, and the house takes six more gold. The fourth player leans back and laughs, a little too loudly.

segments.speaker: Fourth player
segments.text: Tired of counting, and now tired of winning too!

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Hush. Our guest is having an unlucky night, and luck is a tide, my weary friend; it always turns. The cards will be here when you are rested, and so shall we. One more, or will you rest your eyes a while?

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: You're down twenty-six. Another hand, or done for now?
segments.reacts_to: One more, or will you rest your eyes a while?
